req.title: Location header on create
req.statement: The system shall set Location: /players/{new_id} on the 201 Created response.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the Location header must be set correctly when a new player is created. This is crucial for RESTful API design, as it allows clients to know the URI of the newly created resource. The tests will ensure that this behavior is implemented correctly, covering positive, negative, and boundary cases.

tests.name: test_create_player_location_header_positive
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with 26 players.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with valid player data.
expected: The Location header is set to /players/squadnumber/{squad_number}.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "Test",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "squadNumber": 27,
    "position": "Forward"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.headers['Location'] == '/players/squadnumber/27'

tests.name: test_create_player_location_header_negative
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with 26 players.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a duplicate squad number.
expected: The Location header is not set.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "Duplicate",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "squadNumber": 1,
    "position": "Forward"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 409
assert 'Location' not in response.headers

actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with squad number 0.
